name: Hydrogen
shortDescription: The lightest and most abundant element in the universe.

name: Lithium
shortDescription: A soft, silvery-white alkali metal, highly reactive.

name: Carbon
shortDescription: The basis of all known life on Earth.

name: Nitrogen
shortDescription: A colorless gas that makes up most of Earth's atmosphere.

name: Oxygen
shortDescription: Essential for respiration and combustion.

name: Fluorine
shortDescription: The most electronegative and reactive of all elements.

name: Sodium
shortDescription: A soft, silvery-white, highly reactive metal.

name: Magnesium
shortDescription: A shiny gray solid used in lightweight alloys.

name: Silicon
shortDescription: A hard, brittle crystalline solid widely used in electronics.

name: Phosphorus
shortDescription: A highly reactive nonmetal essential for life.

name: Sulfur
shortDescription: A bright yellow, brittle solid.

name: Chlorine
shortDescription: A yellow-green gas commonly used as a disinfectant.

name: Potassium
shortDescription: A soft silvery-white metal that reacts violently with water.

name: Calcium
shortDescription: An alkaline earth metal essential for living organisms.

name: Manganese
shortDescription: A hard, brittle silvery metal often used in steel alloys.

name: Iron
shortDescription: The most common element on Earth by mass.

name: Copper
shortDescription: A soft, malleable metal with very high thermal and electrical conductivity.

name: Selenium
shortDescription: A nonmetal with properties intermediate between sulfur and tellurium.

name: Bromine
shortDescription: A deep red fuming liquid at room temperature.

name: Silver
shortDescription: A soft, white, lustrous transition metal.

name: Iodine
shortDescription: A lustrous, purple-black nonmetallic solid.
